wireContract.reason: Amazon Bedrock is a third-party API we do not serve, so there is no service of ours whose zod could own these shapes and nothing to generate a schema package from (CODING_STANDARDS §15.3 / ADR-0014 / GR-015 §15-d, which names LLM providers explicitly). src/schemas.ts validates the RAW `Converse` response at the boundary with this package's own zod and deliberately differs from the normalized outcome the client returns — and no OpenAPI document is written for an API we do not serve. This marker is per-package and is NOT inherited by name or location.
